name: smn_fcxr2_ref_fa-r2-COMMIT
purpose: HF-5a: native-view fix of the front_c x-write / PR1-line relay. Routed native audit of fc_xr (record 1e78e63ef, smn_fcxr_ref_fa-r2-c1dfe3d51): launch 409 ps on 2,642 xo/lo pins (budget 220) because the ONE register stage sits at the input faces (DEF: u_xd y 141-149 of 151, u_ld at li) and every output wire crosses the 151 um tile. fc_xr2 = same ports / exact pin plan / outline / recipe 2, one more stage: A at xi/li/fi faces, B at xo/lo/fo faces (reg->reg across the tile). +1 cycle on xo, lo, fo equally (fc_b xi stays aligned with li/fi); front_c calendar edge recorded in lanes/HF-5.md (HF-5a). HH-2 10-19: r1 793270d4b EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 = S face (xo, 10.5 pins/um on M5 only) y 0-3 um: 2,642 FIRM BUF+HB2+BUF output stacks (3.21 um, 100% row fill) under the 26-column stage-B flop band; M3 V overflow 1,746 / total 2,795, all 746 hot gcells at y<15 um. The stage-B flops are now at the face (fc_xr had them at the far N face, so S held only the stacks). OT_OUTHOLD_FREE=1: hold pad stays one dont_touch HB2 per pin, only its location is free (m5a/m5b class).
